scope: Flash bridge planning and execution only; UHD modification and diagnosis deferred.

handoff_detection_coverage.scope: Inspected corpus only; no known unrecognized handoff example within these 405 kernels.

design.bridge: A -> AB -> B; independent marker and handoff requirements can compose into three stages.
design.stage: Immutable receiver, optional Kernel, Normal, transfer bytes, required settings and readback expectations.
design.marker_bridge: Temporary accepted target marker, then exact target Kernel restoration.
design.handoff_bridge: Keep source startup and Normal; adapt recognized RAM programmer restart operands to target startup and rebalance checksum. Validate both directed handoffs, ABI, pair integrity and authentication.
design.settings: 0x9F and mechanism settings belong to the stage. Preserve marker-only migration ordering. Changed intermediate Normal images use their own settings transaction.
design.encoding: Per-receiver transfer format and dialect; no model-pair allowlist for handoff bridges.
design.execution: One Pioneer stage executor for complete and Normal-only updates; MediaTek direct and packaged-intermediate updates use one stage loop with protocol-specific low-level commands.
design.failure: No firmware-write retries or automatic rollback/resume. Keep completed-stage evidence on later preflight failures. Restore stage-local settings only before that stage attempts update commands.
design.recovery: Retain generated handoff intermediates in the existing diagnostic report collector. An original backup is not automatically the correct Current after a bridge; explicit forward recovery from the retained bridge is tested.
